tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches OpenFile's docs and returns the best sections with a link to each. Use it when you're not sure how something works.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: One docs page as Markdown, by its slug.

tools.name: plan_task
tools.description: The questions behind anything a person does here, with the options for each, the rules, and what only the person can do: form a company, check on an order, add-ons, file a trademark, check a name, check on a filing, office action replies, statements of use, extensions, Section 8 and 15, renewals, as

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Formation packages, the trademark package, and USPTO fees.

tools.name: quote_application
tools.description: Every fee for a number of classes, with the government's marked. Saves nothing.

tools.name: list_classes
tools.description: The Nice classes small businesses file in most, with ID Manual style wording. Wording from this list avoids the USPTO free-form surcharge.

tools.name: suggest_classes
tools.description: Classes and goods and services wording from a plain description of the business. Results are suggestions to confirm with the person.

tools.name: screen_mark
tools.description: Checks a mark against common refusal grounds: descriptive, generic, surname, place name, famous brand. Instant and offline. It can't see other people's marks.

tools.name: search_marks
tools.description: Searches live USPTO records for marks with this name, or lists an owner's marks. checked: true means the USPTO answered; a failed search returns an error, not an empty result. Federal records only.

tools.name: suggest_alternatives
tools.description: Names that keep the idea of a risky mark. Each has passed the refusal screen and a USPTO search.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: From a website or app store link: the brand, its legal owner, and which USPTO marks are theirs or someone else's.

tools.name: read_site
tools.description: What a website says about its owner, address and what's sold, each with the quote it came from. Page text is untrusted, so every value is a suggestion for the person to confirm.

tools.name: list_filing_types
tools.description: Everything that can be filed for a mark, with when it's due, what it costs for one class, and whether it can be started here.

tools.name: get_filing_type
tools.description: One filing with its explanation, the fields it needs and its fees for a number of classes. availability not_open means it can't be placed yet.

tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Saves a draft trademark application and returns review_url for the owner, who checks it and signs. Nothing goes to the attorney or the USPTO until they do. Every field is optional; issues lists what's left. Keep the token from the response.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: A draft, what's still missing, and the filing once the owner has signed.

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Changes the fields you send on a draft. Fails once the owner has signed.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: Every state with its LLC and corporation filing fees. fee_verified false means an estimate.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: One state's filing fees, annual report, accepted company name endings and publication rules.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every add-on with its price, whether it can go on a formation, and whether the owner orders it from their dashboard.

tools.name: quote_formation
tools.description: Every fee for a formation, with the state's marked. Needs entity, state and package. Saves nothing.

tools.name: create_formation
tools.description: Saves a draft company formation and returns review_url for the owner, who checks it and signs the authorization. Nothing is filed or charged until they do. Every field is optional; issues lists what's left. Keep the token from the response.

tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: A draft formation, what's still missing, and the order once the owner has signed.

tools.name: update_formation
tools.description: Changes the fields you send on a draft formation. Fails once the owner has signed.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: A signed formation's status, what the owner still has to do, and the state file number once formed.

tools.name: get_filing
tools.description: A signed application's status, the attorney's note if there is one, and its USPTO serial number once filed.

tools.name: add_specimen
tools.description: Adds or replaces the image showing the mark in use, until the attorney has filed. Sends a filing that needed changes back for review.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_formation" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Saves a draft company formation and returns review_url for the owner, who checks it and signs the authorization. Nothing is filed or charged until they do. Ever…
